title: Usage, plans, data exports and off-boarding
summary: Masters: set a store's plan, make data exports, and close a store safely with a grace period before its data is deleted.

blocks.text: Open a store and pick **Usage & plan**. Pick a plan and press **Save plan**; the change is audited. Stores that existed before plans are on **Custom** (no limits). **Measure now** refreshes users, items, storage and database size.
On the **Data** tab, **Export all data** makes the same ZIP file the store's owner can make. **Download** creates a fresh Download link.

items: **Archive and delete later**: type the Store ID. The store is archived (nobody can sign in), a final data export is made, and deletion is scheduled after the grace period.
During the grace period, **Cancel deletion** stops it. Tick **Bring the store back** to make it suspended, then Resume it on the Stores tab.
On the date, the daily job deletes the store's data. **Delete store data now** does it early: type the Store ID and your two-step code.

blocks.text: Delete store data drops the store's database and deletes its files and saved keys for good. Download the final data export first.
A store in pilot mode is never deleted automatically, and a store whose final export failed waits for a master.
